sourceText: Sprint review 24: Priya owns the payment retry queue and scheduled cron worker. After benchmark testing, we decided to migrate transaction ledger from MySQL to CockroachDB. Current blocker: Card processor sandbox webhook failure delays settlement testing until Monday.

Clinical core sync: Carlos owns the HIPAA audit log export service. Architecture decision: Adopted WebRTC with TURN relay fallback for video consultations. Urgent blocker: Prescription signing API token expired in staging blocking pharmacy validation.

Dispatch infrastructure retro: Sarah owns the telematics ingestion pipeline. We decided to partition geospatial telemetry by vehicle region to alleviate Redis hotspots. Critical blocker: Kafka broker disk pressure throttling GPS ingest across cluster.
